questions.question: What does update duty fraction establish in this lab?
options: The fraction of this job’s wall time inside the measured synchronized update boundary
questions.explanation: The numerator and denominator describe an application timing boundary. They do not measure device occupancy, memory bandwidth or fleet allocation.
optionFeedback: Wall time inside an update is not a hardware occupancy counter. Use a device profiler for utilization claims.
